title: Windows Settings Automation via UIA + PrintWindow
description: Automate Windows 11 Settings (UWP) via a11y UIA. Navigate via ms-settings: URI, capture via PrintWindow API, invoke buttons by UIA name pattern. Includes local account switch flow.
steps: 1. Open settings page via URI: Start-Process 'ms-settings:<page>' — key pages: yourinfo, accounts-youraccount, signinoptions, windowsupdate
2. Find Settings hwnd: wkappbot a11y find '{title:"설정"}' → extract hwnd from grap line
3. Capture UWP window (a11y screenshot unreliable for UWP): Add-Type PrintWindow DllImport each session → [WC]::Cap([IntPtr]hwnd, 'out.png'). See step 9 for reusable snippet.
4. Invoke button by UIA name: wkappbot a11y invoke '{hwnd:HWND}#*버튼이름*'
5. Read UIA tree: wkappbot a11y read '{hwnd:HWND}' --depth 6 (UWP exposes limited tree — most content not in UIA)
6. GOTCHA — UWP navigation: a11y click/scroll unreliable. Use ms-settings: URI to jump pages directly. Use invoke (not click) for buttons.

7. Local account switch full flow: (A) Start-Process 'ms-settings:yourinfo' → (B) wkappbot a11y invoke '{hwnd:X}#*대신 로컬 계정으로 로그인*' → (C) UserAccountBroker Shell_Dialog appears (proc=UserAccountBroker, cls=Shell_Dialog) → (D) wkappbot a11y invoke '{hwnd:brokerHwnd}#*다음*' → (E) MS identity verify step — user must enter PIN or MS password interactively → (F) set new local username + password → (G) invoke 다음 → reboot prompt

8. Find UserAccountBroker hwnd: wkappbot a11y read '{hwnd:settingsHwnd}' --depth 6 → look for Shell_Dialog / proc=UserAccountBroker in grap output. Or: wkappbot a11y find '{title:"로컬 계정으로 전환"}' after invoking the switch link.

10. Auto-login setup after local account switch: run netplwiz → '사용자 이름과 암호를 입력해야 함' checkbox appears → uncheck → set local password. Or registry: HKLM:\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Winlogon AutoAdminLogon=1, DefaultUserName, DefaultPassword.
requirements: Start-Process 'ms-settings:yourinfo' => Settings app opens on Your Info page (계정 > 사용자 정보)
wkappbot a11y find '{title:"설정"}' => returns hwnd in grap field
wkappbot a11y invoke '{hwnd:X}#*대신 로컬 계정으로 로그인*' => UIA Invoke success, UserAccountBroker Shell_Dialog appears
